prompt: What should someone do if the chalkboard says “Indoor drop-off”?
promptZh: 如果黑板寫著「改到室內回收」，應該怎麼做？

options.text: Wait until 11 for the shed to reopen.
options.zh: 等到十一點，看小屋會不會重新開門。
options.whyZh: 室內回收已經指定市場大廳；並未說小屋十一點會重開。

options.text: Leave the scraps at the garden gate.
options.whyZh: 大門旁的黑板用來看公告，不是回收點。

options.text: Take acceptable scraps to the hall after 11.
options.zh: 十一點過後才把符合規定的廚餘送到市場大廳。
options.whyZh: 更換地點不改時間；仍是九點至十一點。

options.text: Take acceptable scraps to the hall during the normal hours.
options.zh: 在原定時段把符合規定的廚餘送到市場大廳。
options.whyZh: 同一時段指前段的九點至十一點，改的是地點，不是品項與時間。

explanationZh: 同一時段指前段的九點至十一點，改的是地點，不是品項與時間。
evidence: Drop household fruit and vegetable scraps at the garden shed between 9 and 11. Please empty your scraps into the marked tub and take your container home. The volunteers cannot accept meat, fish or packaging, including bags sold as compostable. | If the shed is closed because of heavy rain, check the chalkboard by the gate. When it reads “Indoor drop-off”, bring your scraps to the market hall during the same hours. When it reads “Cancelled”, take everything home. Neither sign changes what the volunteers accept.

vocabulary.note: 把物品拿到指定地點交給工作人員。
